description: HANDOFF #16 — hand-authored starting hub. Lays out 15 rooms with hardcoded directional pointers and fixed NPC anchors so the player has a recognizable home base before they hit the procedural world. v2.4.1 (OTA 030): the same room layout is now reused across all 9 factions; only the displayed minimap title (hubName) varies per faction. factionHubNames + hubLocationIds drive the per-faction skin.

rooms.name: The Gate
rooms.description: A salvaged checkpoint of mud-bricks and pre-flood signage. A burned-iron arch frames the entry. The Reclaimer at the table waves you through without looking up.

rooms.name: The Central Square
rooms.description: A small open square strung with Aetheric lanterns. A worn map-stone sits in the center, the Cradle of Dusk drawn in three different hands. Six paths spoke off in every direction.

rooms.name: The Armory
rooms.description: Racks of mud-iron blades, bolt-casters in various states of repair, a wall of buckler shields. Irma's anvil rings from the back. She nods if you don't waste her time.

rooms.name: The Mess Hall
rooms.description: Long benches under low-hanging Aetheric bulbs. The food is mud-stewed tubers and dried bog-fish, and there's always a pot on. Halem keeps the kettle warm and the gossip warmer.

rooms.name: The Workshop
rooms.description: Tarek the Tinkerer's domain — half-disassembled drones on every bench, sparking conduits, and a runecaster being calibrated in a vise. Smell of ozone and burnt mud.

rooms.name: Sleeping Quarters
rooms.description: Bunk shelves cut into the wall, with rough wool curtains for privacy. Reclaimer kit on most of the racks. A free bunk in the corner is yours when you need it.

rooms.name: The Aether Lab
rooms.description: A small room of glass jars, Aether-charged crystals, and chalkboards covered in cramped handwriting. Jorah looks up from a tome when you enter — unhurried, curious.

rooms.name: The Relic Vault
rooms.description: Aether-shielded shelves behind a quiet door. Tagged crates of un-identified relics waiting on their assessor. The door's lock is mechanical — Reclaimer trust over Reclaimer tech.

rooms.name: The Chapel
rooms.description: An unaffiliated room of soft Aetheric light. Anyone who needs to sit and think comes here. The walls are blank, the silence intentional.

rooms.name: The Culvert Descent
rooms.description: A wide drainage stairwell leading down into the buried levels. The air below is heavier, the lights fewer. The Reclaimers' map ends at the second landing.

rooms.name: First Landing
rooms.description: A wide platform of cracked Tartarian stone. Two corridors open off — one east into the storage halls, one west into the pump room.

rooms.name: Storage Halls
rooms.description: Tartarian crates, most rotted through, some intact. The mud-glass containers in the back row are old enough to count as artifacts.

rooms.name: The Pump Room
rooms.description: Old Aetheric pumps churn the silt-water out of the lower levels. They've been running for centuries. Nobody knows who maintains them.

rooms.name: Second Landing
rooms.description: Where the Reclaimer map ends. The corridor south is unmapped — what little anyone knows ends in 'we lost two teams down there.'

rooms.name: The Shallow Digs
rooms.description: Active Reclaimer excavation. Tarpaulins, rope ladders, lit braziers. The deepest cuts open into mud-glass strata where the Aetheric pulse is loud enough to hear with your teeth.
